limitations: Subscriber counts are series totals, not unique people across both newsletters.
Article views, email opens, announcement impressions and members reached have different denominators; do not combine them into a reader funnel or CTR.
Email sends do not establish inbox delivery. Open rates are LinkedIn-reported, rounded and age-dependent; 7% and 21% are not a like-aged comparison.
Native Article totals engagement and impression labels are retained without inventing definitions.
The five selected sources are not an exhaustive audit of all nine editions or all LinkedIn notifications and DMs.
The native scheduling inventory was verified in the preceding same-day task, not re-audited here. No schedule changed.
No metrics change is attributed to this preparation; no public engagement action was executed.
